basis.sensor_geometry: envs/sensors/tactile.py: GSmini 26.6 x 20.9 mm, 320 x 240; one quarter of the smaller pixel pitch is 20.78125 micrometres.
basis.rgbd: envs/_base_task.py: head/wrist 480 x 270; RGB uint8, depth metres; tactile height_map millimetres.
basis.rendering: tacex_uipc/sim/uipc_sim.py documents one-frame mesh/render lag. Every branch uses exactly two observation warmups, then four live stationary observations; no cached image substitutes for a render.
basis.threshold_status: Engineering qualification budgets declared before the new pair, not native task-success thresholds. Angular differences are diagnostic, not converted with an arbitrary lever arm; actual world UIPC surface displacement (objects and both finger contact surfaces), hand/TCP origin displacement and initial exact joint state are enforced.
basis.exact: Before physical advance: nine UIPC dumps, actual joint positions/velocities and root velocity, commanded targets, runtime RNG/task/actor/marker/reference state, model/physics/assets, intrinsics and camera conventions. Static sampling must not advance physics or change actual joint state/targets.
basis.images: Every RGB image and every 32 x 32 tile must have RMSE <= min(2.55, maximum of six capture-static pair RMSEs + 1 LSB); all six capture-static pairs must themselves satisfy the 2.55 cap. Depth NaN/inf encode invalid background rays; finite nonnegative values are valid. Baseline-valid interiors use maximum absolute metre error and reject gained/lost valid pixels. Baseline discontinuities (>max(1 mm, 1% depth), or valid/invalid transitions), dilated one pixel, use bidirectional 3 x 3 depth correspondence; no unmatched valid point is permitted. Missing data, negative finite depth, wrong shapes or dtypes fail.
basis.continuation: Same three EEF inputs, receipts/counters exact; all actor/gel UIPC world surface vertices and hand/TCP/actor positions use maximum Euclidean displacement <= position_limit_m. Rotation angles, subsequent joint positions/velocities and IK position targets are reported diagnostically rather than using an arbitrary lever arm. Effort/velocity targets remain exact. Per-step UIPC dump changes remain reported.
basis.exclusions: Does not change official success predicates, claim bit-exact GPU evolution, or retrospectively qualify schema-1 runs. Any missing required evidence rejects qualification. Renderer caches and unverified solver internals are not claimed restored.
